subject: Tablecloth order issue
text: I was meant to collect the extra tablecloth after lunch, but the warehouse just said the delivery got rerouted to the depot. I can't get it today now. If the purchase was linked to the rental payment, could you check whether they will still charge the late fee, or do you need the order number from my receipt? I'm leaving the office early, so a fast answer would help. Please check quickly.
